contentType: Original English summaries; supplemental options, not SRD content.

subclasses.name: Path of the Wild Heart
subclasses.description: Channel animal spirits through Rage.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals, using Wisdom.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.description: Choose Bear, Eagle, or Wolf whenever you enter Rage for resistance, mobility, or allied attacks.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.description: Choose Owl, Panther, or Salmon after a Long Rest to improve perception, climbing, or swimming.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.description: Cast Commune with Nature as a ritual using Wisdom.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.description: Choose Falcon, Lion, or Ram when entering Rage for flight, protection, or knocking enemies Prone.

subclasses.name: Path of the World Tree
subclasses.description: Protect companions and teleport through supernatural roots.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description: Entering Rage grants Temporary Hit Points; during Rage, share temporary vitality with nearby allies.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While Raging, use a Reaction to teleport a nearby creature beside you and potentially stop its movement.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: Heavy or Versatile Melee weapons gain reach and can add Push or Topple mastery.

features.name: Travel Along the Tree
features.description: Teleport during Rage, with a longer journey that can carry nearby willing companions.

subclasses.name: Path of the Zealot
subclasses.description: Combine divine damage with supernatural endurance.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While Raging, your first weapon or Unarmed Strike hit each turn adds Radiant or Necrotic damage.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spend healing dice as a Bonus Action to recover Hit Points; regain the pool after a Long Rest.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once per Rage, reroll a failed saving throw with a Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: A Bonus Action grants nearby allies Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn.

features.name: Rage of the Gods
features.description: Empower a Rage with flight and resistances; expend Rage to rescue an ally from dropping.

subclasses.name: College of Dance
subclasses.description: Use movement and unarmed combat to inspire allies.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description: Gain unarmored defense, dance proficiency benefits, and Bardic Inspiration-powered Unarmed Strikes.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: Spend Bardic Inspiration as a Reaction to move yourself and an ally without Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: Spend Bardic Inspiration when rolling Initiative to improve nearby allies' Initiative.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: Successful Dexterity saves avoid damage; nearby companions can share this protection.

subclasses.name: College of Glamour
subclasses.description: Weave fey enchantment into inspiring performances.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.description: Enchantments and illusions can Charm or Frighten a witness; gain Charm Person and Mirror Image.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: Spend Bardic Inspiration to grant Temporary Hit Points and let allies reposition.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: Cast Command through a magical mantle; a level 3+ slot can restore its use.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: Manifest fey majesty that can make incoming attacks miss.

subclasses.name: College of Valor
subclasses.description: Blend weapons, armor, and spellcasting.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration can improve weapon damage or Armor Class.

features.name: Martial Training
features.description: Gain Martial weapon proficiency and Medium armor and Shield training; weapons can serve as spellcasting foci.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice; one attack can be replaced by an action cantrip.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: After casting an action spell, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

subclasses.name: Light Domain
subclasses.description: Defend allies and burn enemies with divine light.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
features.description: Your domain spells are always prepared.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: Use a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack against a nearby creature.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity to dispel magical darkness and damage nearby enemies with Radiant light.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: Warding Flare also grants Temporary Hit Points and recharges on Short Rests.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: Create a radiant aura that weakens saves against your Fire, Radiant, and Radiance of the Dawn effects.

subclasses.name: Trickery Domain
subclasses.description: Use deception and a divine duplicate.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
features.description: Your domain spells are always prepared.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: Grant yourself or another creature Advantage on Stealth checks until your next Long Rest.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to create a duplicate without Concentration.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: Swap places with your duplicate when creating or moving it.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: The duplicate helps allies attack nearby foes and can restore Hit Points when it ends.

subclasses.name: War Domain
subclasses.description: Turn divine power into martial strength.

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.description: Your domain spells are always prepared.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: Make a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action; recharge on Short or Long Rests.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity to add +10 to a failed attack roll.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot or Concentration.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.description: Specialize in powerful Beast transformations.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Wild Shape permits CR equal to Druid level divided by three, improved Armor Class, and triple-level Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.description: Your circle spells are always prepared and can be cast in Wild Shape.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: Beast attacks can deal Radiant damage; add Wisdom to Constitution saves while transformed.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.description: Teleport as a Bonus Action and gain Advantage on your next attack this turn.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: Beast attacks add Radiant damage once per turn; Moonlight Step can carry a willing companion.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Sea
subclasses.description: Harness storms and crashing waves.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.description: Your circle spells are always prepared.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: Spend Wild Shape for an ocean aura; a Bonus Action can damage and push a nearby creature.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: Gain a Swim Speed and expand the reach of Wrath of the Sea.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: Wrath of the Sea grants flight and Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: Share Wrath of the Sea with a willing creature; spend additional Wild Shape to protect both.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Stars
subclasses.description: Read constellations and assume celestial forms.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: Gain a star-map focus, Guidance, and Guiding Bolt with limited free castings.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: Spend Wild Shape for an Archer, Chalice, or Dragon constellation that improves attacks, healing, or concentration.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a Long Rest, an omen lets Reactions improve allies' rolls or hinder enemies.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Improve your constellation benefits and change constellation at the start of each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: Starry Form grants Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: Control combat with tactical maneuvers.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: Learn maneuvers fueled by Superiority Dice, recovered after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: Gain one skill and one Artisan's Tools proficiency.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: A Bonus Action reveals a creature's damage Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Once per turn, use a d8 for a maneuver instead of expending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice become d12s.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: Combine Fighter attacks with Wizard magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare Wizard spells using Intelligence and the subclass spellcasting table, without school restrictions.

features.name: War Bond
features.description: Bond with weapons to resist disarming and summon a bonded weapon.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: Replace one attack in the Attack action with an action Wizard cantrip.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: A weapon hit hinders the target's next saving throw against your magic.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: Teleport when you use Action Surge.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: Replace two attacks with an action level 1 or 2 Wizard spell.

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.description: Enhance combat through psionic power.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Spend Psionic Energy Dice on Protective Field, Psionic Strike, and Telekinetic Movement.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: Gain Psi-Powered Leap and the ability to move or topple targets with Psionic Strike.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: Resist Psychic damage and expend psionic energy to end Charmed or Frightened.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: Protect nearby creatures with Half Cover.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: Cast Telekinesis using Intelligence and combine its control with weapon attacks.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Mercy
subclasses.description: Use martial arts to heal or inflict suffering.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Spend Focus to add Necrotic damage to an Unarmed Strike once per turn.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: Spend Focus to heal a touched creature, or replace a Flurry of Blows strike with healing.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: Gain Insight, Medicine, and Herbalism Kit proficiency.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: Hand of Healing removes harmful conditions; Hand of Harm can inflict Poisoned.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: Flurry of Blows can provide additional healing and harm without their usual Focus costs.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: Spend 5 Focus to revive a creature dead less than 24 hours; once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Shadow
subclasses.description: Control darkness and teleport between shadows.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: Learn Minor Illusion, gain Darkvision, and spend Focus to cast and reposition Darkness you can see through.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: Teleport between areas of Dim Light or Darkness and gain Advantage on your next melee attack.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.description: Spend Focus to ignore Shadow Step's lighting restriction and make an Unarmed Strike after teleporting.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: Spend Focus for invisibility, movement through creatures, and free Flurry of Blows while shadows persist.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Elements
subclasses.description: Infuse unarmed combat with elemental power.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: Spend Focus to extend Unarmed Strike reach, change elemental damage, and push or pull targets.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.description: Learn Elementalism, using Wisdom.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.description: Spend Focus to damage creatures in an elemental Sphere.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.description: Elemental Attunement grants Fly and Swim Speeds.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.description: Attunement grants elemental Resistance, increased damage, and damaging movement.

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory
subclasses.description: Inspire heroic deeds through athletic prowess.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.description: Your oath spells are always prepared.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.description: After Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity to distribute Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity to improve athletic checks, carrying, and jumping for an hour.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: Increase your Speed and the Speed of allies in your Aura of Protection.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.description: Use a Reaction to protect a nearby ally and potentially counterattack.

features.name: Living Legend
features.description: Assume a legendary form with enhanced Charisma checks, attacks, and saving throws.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Ancients
subclasses.description: Protect life with primal divine magic.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.description: Your oath spells are always prepared.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity to Restrain nearby enemies with spectral vines.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: Your Aura of Protection grants Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: Survive dropping to zero Hit Points with substantial healing; resist aging.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description: Assume a primal form with regeneration, faster spellcasting, and stronger magic.

subclasses.name: Oath of Vengeance
subclasses.description: Pursue and punish a chosen enemy.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.description: Your oath spells are always prepared.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.description: Spend Channel Divinity during an attack to gain Advantage against a foe; transfer the vow after its defeat.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: Opportunity Attack hits halt the target and let you move without provoking.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: React to an attack by your vowed enemy with a melee attack.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description: Gain flight and a terrifying aura; a level 5 spell slot restores this transformation.

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description: Fight beside a primal Beast companion.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: Summon a Beast of the Land, Sea, or Sky; command it using a Bonus Action or an attack.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: Your companion can take additional mobility actions and deal Force damage.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: The companion attacks twice and benefits from your Hunter's Mark damage.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: Spells targeting yourself can also affect your nearby companion.

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.description: Mix fey charm with psychic weapon strikes.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: Weapon hits add Psychic damage, once per target each turn.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.description: Your fey spells are always prepared.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: Add Wisdom to Charisma checks and gain one social skill proficiency.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.description: Resist charm and fear; redirect those effects when nearby creatures resist them.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: Gain Summon Fey, a free casting, and the option to remove its Concentration.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: Cast Misty Step freely a limited number of times and bring a nearby companion.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.description: Ambush enemies and evade their sight.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: Improve Initiative and opening movement; Dreadful Strike adds Psychic damage a limited number of times.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.description: Your gloom spells are always prepared.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: Gain Darkvision and evade creatures relying on Darkvision to see you in darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Gain Wisdom saving throw proficiency, or another eligible save if already proficient.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Dreadful Strike can trigger an additional attack or frighten nearby enemies.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: Use a Reaction to hinder an incoming attack and teleport.

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.description: Use Wizard magic to enhance stealth and trickery.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare Wizard spells using Intelligence; learn Mage Hand and additional cantrips.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Your invisible Mage Hand can perform delicate tasks and be controlled with Cunning Action.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: Casting while hidden can impose Disadvantage on enemies' saves against your spell.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: Cunning Strike's Trip can target another creature near Mage Hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: Use a Reaction to steal an eligible enemy spell after resisting it.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.description: Excel at ambushes, poisons, and infiltration.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Gain Initiative Advantage, first-round attack benefits, and additional Sneak Attack damage equal to Rogue level.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.description: Gain Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit proficiency.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: Improve impersonation and retain movement after Steady Aim.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.description: Your Poison Cunning Strike deals extra Poison damage and ignores Poison Resistance.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: First-round Sneak Attacks can deal doubled damage after a failed Constitution save.

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.description: Manifest psychic blades and telepathic talents.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Use Psionic Energy Dice to improve failed proficient checks and establish telepathic communication.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Create Psychic blades with Vex mastery; use them for attacks, including Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: Use psionic energy to guide missed blade attacks or teleport.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: Become Invisible, ending when you damage a creature or force a save.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: A Psychic Blade Sneak Attack can Stun a target.

subclasses.name: Aberrant Sorcery
subclasses.description: Manifest telepathy and alien psychic magic.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: Your psionic spells are always prepared.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: Create a temporary two-way telepathic connection with another creature.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: Cast psionic spells using Sorcery Points instead of slots and bypass most components.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: Resist Psychic damage and gain Advantage against Charmed and Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description: Spend Sorcery Points to gain supernatural senses, flight, swimming, or an amorphous body.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: Teleport and drag nearby creatures toward your former position with Force damage.

subclasses.name: Clockwork Sorcery
subclasses.description: Restore cosmic order through protective magic.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
features.description: Your clockwork spells are always prepared.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: Use a Reaction to cancel Advantage or Disadvantage on a nearby creature's d20 roll.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: Spend Sorcery Points to grant protective dice that reduce damage.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: Enter a state that neutralizes enemy Advantage and treats your low d20 rolls as 10.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description: Summon spirits that heal, repair objects, and end qualifying spells.

subclasses.name: Wild Magic Sorcery
subclasses.description: Channel unpredictable magic and influence fate.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Your spells can trigger a roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Gain Advantage on a d20 Test; a later spell triggers a surge and restores this benefit.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point as a Reaction to add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's d20 roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Roll twice for a Wild Magic Surge and choose the result.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.description: Once per Long Rest, select a qualifying Wild Magic Surge outcome instead of rolling.

subclasses.name: Archfey Patron
subclasses.description: Teleport through the battlefield with fey magic.

features.name: Archfey Spells
features.description: Your patron spells are always prepared.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.description: Gain free Misty Step castings and additional effects when you teleport.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction to taking damage, with additional teleport effects.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: Become immune to Charmed; reduce incoming damage and potentially redirect it.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.description: Casting an action Enchantment or Illusion spell can include a free Misty Step.

subclasses.name: Celestial Patron
subclasses.description: Draw on radiant power to heal and protect.

features.name: Celestial Spells
features.description: Your patron spells and bonus cantrips are always prepared.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: Spend a pool of d6s as a Bonus Action to heal a nearby creature.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Resist Radiant damage and add Charisma to one Fire or Radiant spell damage roll per turn.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: Magical Cunning and rests grant Temporary Hit Points to you and companions.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: Rescue yourself or an ally from a death saving throw with healing and a radiant burst.

subclasses.name: Great Old One Patron
subclasses.description: Assault minds and command aberrant power.

features.name: Great Old One Spells
features.description: Your patron spells are always prepared.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: Create a two-way telepathic connection.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.description: Change spell damage to Psychic and cast Enchantment or Illusion Warlock spells without Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.description: Use Awakened Mind to predict a creature's attacks and improve your own against it.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.description: Hex also hinders saves of the chosen ability.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Resist Psychic damage, protect your thoughts, and reflect Psychic damage.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: Empower Summon Aberration with reduced Concentration requirements, temporary vitality, and Hex synergy.

subclasses.name: Abjurer
subclasses.description: Protect yourself and allies with an arcane ward.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Add free Abjuration spells to your spellbook now and when unlocking new spell levels.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: Abjuration spells create a protective ward; spell slots can directly replenish it.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: Use a Reaction to let your ward absorb damage to a nearby creature.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.description: Counterspell and Dispel Magic are always prepared; failed castings preserve slots and Dispel Magic can use a Bonus Action.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: Gain Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

subclasses.name: Diviner
subclasses.description: Foresee outcomes and reveal hidden truths.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Add free Divination spells to your spellbook now and when unlocking new spell levels.

features.name: Portent
features.description: Record two d20 rolls after a Long Rest and substitute them for eligible d20 Tests.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: Casting a Divination spell with a slot recovers a lower-level spell slot.

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: A Bonus Action grants a supernatural sight option, including enhanced Darkvision or See Invisibility.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: Record three Portent rolls instead of two.

subclasses.name: Illusionist
subclasses.description: Create convincing illusions and phantasmal allies.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Add free Illusion spells to your spellbook now and when unlocking new spell levels.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.description: Enhance Minor Illusion, ignore Illusion Verbal components, and improve qualifying spell ranges.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.description: Gain Summon Beast and Summon Fey, including free illusion-based castings with modified creatures.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: Use a Reaction to make a triggering hit miss; a level 2+ slot restores this feature.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: Temporarily make one nonmagical object in an illusion real without dealing direct harm.

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.description: Dark tendrils strike nearby creatures. A failed Strength save deals Necrotic damage and prevents Reactions until the next turn.

spells.name: Crusader's Mantle
spells.description: An aura empowers nearby allies: weapon and Unarmed Strike hits deal additional Radiant damage.

spells.name: Fount of Moonlight
spells.description: Moonlight grants Radiant Resistance and extra Radiant damage on melee hits. React to damage to potentially Blind the attacker.

spells.name: Hunger of Hadar
spells.description: Create an otherworldly sphere of darkness and Difficult Terrain that harms creatures with Cold and Acid damage.

spells.name: Mind Sliver
spells.description: An Intelligence save resists Psychic damage and a 1d4 penalty to the next saving throw before your next turn ends.

spells.name: Steel Wind Strike
spells.description: Make melee spell attacks against up to five creatures, dealing Force damage on hits, then teleport beside a target.
spells.material: A Melee weapon worth at least 1 GP.

spells.name: Summon Aberration
spells.description: Summon a spirit using the spell's stat block. Choose Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad; its statistics scale with the slot used.
spells.material: The spell-specific component worth at least 400 GP.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.description: Summon a spirit using the spell's stat block. Choose Air, Land, or Water; its statistics scale with the slot used.
spells.material: The spell-specific component worth at least 200 GP.

spells.name: Summon Celestial
spells.description: Summon a spirit using the spell's stat block. Choose Avenger or Defender; its statistics scale with the slot used.
spells.material: The spell-specific component worth at least 500 GP.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.description: Summon a spirit using the spell's stat block. Choose Clay, Metal, or Stone; its statistics scale with the slot used.
spells.material: The spell-specific component worth at least 400 GP.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.description: Summon a spirit using the spell's stat block. Choose Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy; its statistics scale with the slot used.
spells.material: The spell-specific component worth at least 300 GP.

spells.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
spells.description: A majestic emanation can inflict Psychic damage, knock creatures Prone, and push them away after a failed Wisdom save.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: Perceive through a willing Beast you touch. While sharing its senses, you cannot use your own sight or hearing.
